case_note.test_value: Still editable after pen and signature

test_cases.actions: Edit all editable native fields, toggle checks twice, change radio, dropdown and list twice; export and reopen.
test_cases.assert: All expected AcroForm /V values AND appearances survive in PDF.js and independent viewer. Read-only ID unchanged.

test_cases.actions: Edit case_note, draw strokes, erase one, undo/redo, add/move text and tick, import demo-signature-transparent.png, resize and move.
test_cases.assert: No native value or overlay disappears on tool/page switches; exported appearance matches editor.

test_cases.actions: At rotated 90-degree page, place three X strokes and text at labelled targets, zoom, export.
test_cases.assert: All are at intended displayed locations with no mirrored or shifted stroke/signature geometry.

test_cases.actions: Fill apparent printed boxes using overlay tools; select/correct and export.
test_cases.assert: Raster background remains intact; additions survive independent PDF viewer.

test_cases.actions: With browser Network recording, open sample, draw, import PNG, save and print.
test_cases.assert: No document/signature bytes transmitted or silently persisted. Host may load ordinary app assets.
Clear unsupported/password notice; no blank export falsely reported as complete.
Clear load error; existing unrelated unsaved document work preserved.
Print preview uses completed PDF. Saved or printed PDF agrees with independent viewer.

limits: Not a genuine XFA fixture; genuine samples need separate vetted test documents.
Does not test live personal data or legally meaningful signatures.
Browser interaction success is not proof of PDF interoperability.
